name: prose-tell-scan
description: Deterministic prose review: catalogued AI writing tells plus cadence metrics, report-only.

interface.shortDescription: Counts the writing tics a model cannot count about itself.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic scanner for prose. It reports catalogued AI writing tells as a density per 1000 words, with a line number and the surrounding sentence for every hit, alongside a rhythm fingerprint: sentence-length variance, repeated openers, paragraph distribution, uniform-length runs. Thresholds are register-dependent and derived from your own corpus rather than hand-set, because a flat rhythm is correct in a reference doc and a symptom in an essay. Report-only: it never edits, and it produces signals for an author to weigh about their own draft, never a verdict about who wrote something. NOTE: the scanner itself ports perfectly to Codex — it is a Node script, so the numbers are identical everywhere. What Codex does not provide is skill dispatch, so invoke it directly rather than expecting it to trigger on its own.
defaultPrompt: Scan this draft for AI writing tells
Check whether my revision actually removed the tells
Calibrate a writing profile against my own corpus
